name: @microsoft/mxc-sdk-nanvix-win32-x64
description: Opt-in NanVix MicroVM runtime for @microsoft/mxc-sdk on win32-x64.

scripts.prepack: node -e "const f=require('fs');if(!f.existsSync('wxc-exec.exe')||!f.existsSync('nanvixd.exe')){console.error('prepack: wxc-exec.exe and nanvixd.exe must be staged; refusing to pack an incomplete NanVix package');process.exit(1)}"

author: Microsoft Corporation
